titulo_es: A claim · Purchasing, return and guarantee

texto: When reading a return policy, it separates the time limit, the required status from the article and the voucher. «Hvis» can introduce a condition; the order of prayer depends on whether it is principal or subordinate.
Compare the two tracks and distinguish what the text says from what it only seems to suggest.
